attempts.prompt: Over-the-shoulder editorial photo of a woman with wavy, softly layered hair falling just below the jaw, glancing toward a salon mirror while a stylist holds a section of her hair between two fingers to check the length. Natural window light, neutral tones, the back and side of her head in focus rather than a front-on face.
issues: The hair ends at roughly the jaw/nape line as a fairly blunt, short bob rather than falling visibly 'just below the jaw' as an extended lob; from the back view the length end-point relative to the jaw corners is not clearly shown, undermining the stated purpose of illustrating a slightly-below-jaw length.
The stylist holds the hair end with a flat hand/fingers at the bottom edge rather than pinching a section between two fingers to check length, so the length-check action is only loosely depicted.
The woman is not glancing toward the mirror; her face is turned in profile away from the mirror, and the mirror reflection shows a back-of-head view that doesn't clearly convey the glance.
Stylist's hand and forearm appear slightly elongated/awkward in proportion relative to the body, which is cropped oddly at the left edge.
